Daily announcement for a punctual morning
Please take a moment

Important notice for travelers

Travelers with companion animals must review their plans before heading to the gate, because checks at the Companion Animal Travel Desk are moving quickly and incomplete papers will slow boarding.

Please keep carriers closed, leash items ready, and all care notes within reach. <<FACT F009>> Bring only what is needed for a calm handoff, and stay alert for staff directions so your pet can move through the process without delay.

For travelers connecting through another stop, the pet lounge guidance must also be confirmed in advance. <<FACT F020>> <<FACT F002>> If your animal needs rest, water, or a quiet pause, tell the desk staff at once so support can be arranged without confusion.

Aurelia Skyways asks all travelers to come prepared, speak clearly with staff, and check every companion travel document before departure. This helps protect your pet and keeps the morning flow steady for everyone.

Please go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk now for assistance.
